reference_policy: No private text-task shape target; images compare public visible content; edits compare frozen before/target within permitted scope.
focus:
雪原骑士：恢复阴云日光层次；精确数值由程序测量；
Correct lighting toward the supplied subdued snow-rider target, not generic bright white daylight; Restore readable rider and horse foreground form without silhouette collapse; Retain target-consistent snow relief and directional long shadow contrast; Keep distant fortress, mountain and sky separated at the target relative brightness; Demonstrate changes through permitted light color/energy and world strength, without compensating through new lights or exposure; exact controls are automatic. Read the original edit scope. Existing background defects are not new edit defects. Exact dimensions and light controls remain automatic.
